kind: Bounded model/peer Scatter addition semantic audit; not a provider acceptance or performance result

sources.observation: MoE aggregate combines per-expert views using ggml_add in expert order; this is one implementation structure, not a universal cross-backend rounding requirement
Native FusedMoE uses einsum reduction over experts; alternative native path multiplies in top-k weight dtype, sums along expert axis, then casts once to output dtype
Compiled MoE combine dispatches to original library reductions; torch implementation sums expert dimension and then applies routed scale

mature_public_contract.observation: All indexed updates contribute; CUDA execution may be nondeterministic. This supports reduction semantics, not identical HYLE shape/ownership/error contracts.

existing_failure_preserved: Original MLX scatter_add fails the old ordered-F32-fold contract for 3 of 4 recorded adversarial inputs; those results are not rewritten as PASS
requirement_basis: C0 fixed model precision profiles and end-to-end error gates remain binding
decision: Assignment remains storage-exact/last logical update; floating addition is a reduction of base plus every update, may reassociate and use storage precision or wider, without cross-execution bitwise or row-major-fold guarantees. Explicit F32 model intermediates use existing Cast/F32 ports. No narrowing of required model precision, skipped indices, saturation or dropped updates.
traits_fix: Scatter assign retains kExact; Scatter add uses existing kAccumulateInOutputType with unspecified wider intermediate allowed by this operation contract; no new fields/enums/ABI or hot dispatch
verification_boundary: Mature implementations still require independent numerical, resource, checked failure and delivery qualification; old frozen implementation is neither read, executed as a comparison, modified nor deleted
